selectionRationale: logo-07-signal-gate has the strongest desktop-icon silhouette, stays readable at 16px and 32px, fits the existing dark trading workbench, and avoids the closer resemblance risks of the symmetric knot and monoline A candidates.

candidates.prompt: Abstract orbital A monogram for a premium quantitative trading platform; flat geometric mark on chroma-key background, low-color graphite, silver, muted teal palette, no text.
candidates.styleNotes: Angular A with orbital accent and strong AI-company signal.
weaknesses: more literal than the selected mark

candidates.prompt: Compact aperture or ring mark with implied signal axis; premium geometric logo on chroma-key background, no text, no chart cliches.
